definition: Compensation outside regular base wages that did not fit a more specific category.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 292 distinct documented non base compensation other implementation events across 195 municipalities in 18 states. Compensation outside regular base wages that did not fit a more specific category. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
